# agentgateway_config_resources (Data Source)

Lists the resources of any config resource kind, sorted by id. `kind` is validated loosely so a kind added by a future gateway release works without a provider release. `value_json` is marked sensitive because some kinds carry key material.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the llm.provider resources whose id starts with "shared-".
data "agentgateway_config_resources" "providers" {
  kind      = "llm.provider"
  id_prefix = "shared-"
}

# List every virtual API key. value_json is sensitive, so it is not exported.
data "agentgateway_config_resources" "api_keys" {
  kind = "llm.apiKey"
}

output "provider_ids" {
  value = [for resource in data.agentgateway_config_resources.providers.resources : resource.id]
}

output "api_key_revisions" {
  value = {
    for resource in data.agentgateway_config_resources.api_keys.resources : resource.id => resource.revision
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Config resource kind to list, such as `llm.provider`, `traffic.gateway` or `llm.apiKey`.

### Optional

- `id_prefix` (String) Only include resources whose id starts with this prefix. An empty prefix includes every resource of the kind.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier of the listing: `<kind>:<id_prefix>`.
- `resources` (Attributes List) The matching resources, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format, when the gateway reports it.
- `id` (String) Resource id.
- `revision` (Number) Stored revision; `0` when the gateway omits it.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp in RFC 3339 format, when the gateway reports it.
- `value_json` (String, Sensitive) The resource value exactly as the gateway stores it. Marked sensitive as a whole.
